decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint is a core pipeline fitting close to the firm's established offer for water utilities and plant builders, so it fits its capabilities and customer base.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core business but uses existing coating and fabrication equipment and sells to municipalities the firm already serves, so keeping it costs little.
The waste bin with ashtray is a low-cost variant of the bin line that fits municipal customers and existing powder-coating capacity, though demand is uncertain.
Outdoor ashtrays complement the street-furniture line and use existing processes, but this is a niche far from the core business and the most likely of the line to be trimmed.
